stories.headline: Donald Trump says he is losing patience with Iran after talks with China's Xi
stories.summary: Donald Trump has warned of continued "decimation" of Iran despite China's call for an immediate end to the conflict. Trump held key talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, discussing the Iran situation among other topics. The US President expressed frustration over stalled talks with Tehran, stating that the ceasefire is now "on life support." Trump rejected Iran's latest proposal ahead of his visit to China, leading to unresolved negotiations. Following his talks with Xi, Trump indicated he is losing patience with Iran, suggesting a potential escalation of tensions. The situation remains unresolved, with China urging an immediate end to the conflict, while the US appears to be considering further action against Iran. Trump's visit to China and talks with Xi aimed to address trade, geopolitics, and the Iran conflict.

stories.headline: Trump warns Iran his ‘patience is running out’ after meeting Xi Jinping
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump warned that his patience with Iran is "running out" after meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing. The warning comes amid stalled negotiations and rising tensions in the Gulf. Trump's statement was made after discussions with Xi, where the costly and unpopular war with Iran was likely discussed. The White House has also stated that Iran is running out of time to agree to a new nuclear deal. This warning follows recent violent suppression of protests by Iranian authorities. Trump signaled frustration with Iran, indicating that he may not remain patient for much longer. The situation highlights escalating tensions between the US and Iran, with the US pushing for a new nuclear agreement and Iran facing internal unrest and external pressure. Trump's warning suggests a potential escalation of US action against Iran.

stories.headline: 'Peace can't be piecemeal': India voices concern over Strait of Hormuz, Gaza at BRICS conclave
stories.summary: India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar expressed concerns over the West Asia crisis, Strait of Hormuz tensions, and unilateral sanctions at the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting. He emphasized the need for dialogue and maritime stability, stating that "stability cannot be selective, peace cannot be piecemeal." Jaishankar highlighted the impact of the crisis on energy supplies and urged BRICS nations to develop practical ways to navigate geopolitical upheavals. The meeting, held in New Delhi, saw India flagging grave concerns over the situation in West Asia, including the Gaza conflict, and its effects on global stability. Jaishankar called for collective action to address these challenges, promoting a peaceful and stable environment in the region. The two-day BRICS conclave aims to discuss key global issues and strengthen cooperation among member nations.

stories.headline: Ziyambi tells South Africa amid xenophobic attacks
stories.summary: Ziyambi Ziyambi, Zimbabwe's Minister of Justice, Legal and Parliamentary Affairs, has stated that the government cannot intervene in issues in South Africa. This comes amid xenophobic attacks and increasing diplomatic tensions between South Africa and several African countries, including Nigeria. The South African government has condemned xenophobia, with a statement saying there is no place for it in the country. Protests have erupted in Pretoria and Johannesburg, with hundreds demanding stricter enforcement of immigration laws. The Nigerian government has spoken out against the alleged harassment, humiliation, and extrajudicial killings of Nigerians in South Africa. Zimbabwe's government is in communication with South African authorities, but has stated it will not intervene in their internal affairs. The situation remains tense, with diplomatic relations between South Africa and other African countries under strain.

stories.headline: Meta has rolled out Instants on Instagram globally, introducing disappearing photo-sharing inside DMs and entering a product category long associated with Snapc
stories.summary: Meta has launched Instants on Instagram globally, allowing users to share disappearing photos inside direct messages. The feature enables users to send unedited, ephemeral photos that can only be viewed once and remain available for 24 hours. A new standalone app called "Instants" has also been introduced, connecting to a user's Instagram account. This app focuses on simple, private photo sharing outside the main Instagram platform. The launch of Instants marks Instagram's entry into a product category long associated with Snapchat. The new feature is designed to provide users with a more private and casual way to share photos, and will help Instagram better understand how users engage with ephemeral content. The rollout of Instants is part of Meta's efforts to expand Instagram's features and improve user experience.

stories.headline: Microsoft Teams is ditching Together mode to focus on what actually matters - video quality
stories.summary: Microsoft is retiring Together mode from Teams, a feature introduced during the remote work boom, to focus on improving video quality. The decision is driven by the fact that the modern Gallery view can display up to 49 participants at once, meeting the core need Together mode was designed to support. The retirement of Together mode is scheduled to begin on June 30, 2026. Microsoft plans to invest in improvements that benefit every Teams meeting, such as video quality, stability, and performance. The company aims to simplify the meeting interface and deliver a more consistent experience across devices by optimizing client-rendered video. This change is intended to provide a better overall meeting experience for Teams users. The phased retirement of Together mode and related experiences will be completed by June 2026.

stories.headline: Sega announced that it's changing the price for three of its games on Steam. The affected titles will get a permanent price drop for its base price, as in
stories.summary: Sega has announced a permanent price drop for the base price of three of its games on Steam. The affected titles include Like a Dragon: Ishin, with the new pricing aimed at making the games more accessible to a wider audience. This move comes as concerns about Steam prices have been ongoing, with Valve recently introducing new pricing tools to help developers set fair regional prices. The price reduction is a permanent change to the base price of the games, and it is not a temporary sale or promotion. Sega's decision may be seen as a response to the current market trends, where price hikes have been a point of contention for some gamers, as recently seen with Nintendo's price increases. The exact new prices for the affected Sega titles have not been specified.

stories.headline: One of the most exciting gaming crossovers of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2 has officially arrived, and the Overwatch collaboration is now live in t
stories.summary: Epic Games has released the Fortnite 40.40 update, bringing the final major patch of Chapter 7 Season 2. The update includes a highly anticipated crossover with Overwatch, featuring new skins and quests. The collaboration introduces limited-time quests, providing an opportunity for players to quickly level up their Battle Pass. The Overwatch crossover is part of the Rivalries event, which continues to unfold in the game. The new update is now live, following a period of server downtime for maintenance. Players can expect new content, including recognizable Overwatch characters and cosmetics, to enhance their Fortnite experience. The crossover event offers a fresh set of challenges and rewards, making it an attractive option for players seeking to earn XP and progress through the Battle Pass.

stories.headline: IPL 2026: Mumbai Indians Finally Reveal Full Story Of Hardik Pandya's Continued Absence
stories.summary: Mumbai Indians captain Hardik Pandya has missed several games in the IPL 2026 season due to injury. He was not given medical clearance to play in the match against Royal Challengers Bengaluru, leading to Suryakumar Yadav taking over as captain. Despite being seen practicing in the nets before a match against Punjab Kings, teammate Shardul Thakur revealed that Hardik has not fully recovered from his injury. As a result, he has missed three games for Mumbai Indians, putting their playoff hopes at risk. The franchise's medical team has been cautious with Hardik's recovery, prioritizing his health over rushing him back into the game. His continued absence has been a significant blow to the team, with his return eagerly awaited. Mumbai Indians' playoff chances remain uncertain without their key player.

stories.headline: Pressure just an excuse to practise more: Virat Kohli’s vintage IPL ton sinks KKR
stories.summary: Virat Kohli scored his ninth IPL century, an unbeaten 105, to guide Royal Challengers Bengaluru to a six-wicket win over Kolkata Knight Riders. The vintage performance in Raipur on Wednesday silenced critics who had questioned his strike rate and recent form. Kohli's century showed that he can still deliver under pressure, a situation he described as a "privilege" that keeps him humble and helps him improve his game. Dwayne Bravo praised Kohli's masterclass, which led RCB to victory. The win was a testament to Kohli's ability to perform under pressure, and he stated that he uses pressure as an opportunity to practise and improve, rather than making it an excuse. The century was a reminder of Kohli's skill and experience in the IPL.

stories.headline: Ban Arshdeep: L Sivaramakrishnan urges BCCI action for Tilak Varma racist remark
stories.summary: Former India spinner Laxman Sivaramakrishnan has called for a season-long ban for Punjab Kings pacer Arshdeep Singh due to a viral video where Arshdeep allegedly directed a racist comment. Sivaramakrishnan posted on social media that Arshdeep should be banned for the season and paid on a pro rata basis, stating that players should be "hit where it hurts the most." The incident occurred during an interaction between Arshdeep and another cricketer, with some fans defending it as harmless banter. However, Sivaramakrishnan and others have condemned the comment, urging the BCCI to take action against Arshdeep. The clip has generated significant controversy, with many reacting to the incident and calling for disciplinary action against the Punjab Kings player. Sivaramakrishnan's comments have sparked a debate on social media regarding the appropriate punishment for Arshdeep.

stories.headline: Arsenal scent Premier League glory
stories.summary: Arsenal's 2-1 defeat at Manchester City has proven to be a "reset moment" for the team, according to Coach Mikel Arteta. Since the loss, Arsenal has won all three of their league matches without conceding a goal. Arteta stated that the defeat was used as fuel to increase conviction and learn from their experiences. The team has applied these lessons and now hopes to move closer to their first Premier League title since 2004. With their recent winning streak, Arsenal is poised to potentially claim the top spot in the league. Arteta's strategy appears to be working, as the team has shown improvement and resilience following the setback against City. Arsenal's upcoming matches will be crucial in determining their chances of winning the Premier League title.

stories.headline: Petrol Diesel Prices Hike LIVE Updates, Fuel Prices Hiked By Rs 3, Petrol Diesel News Rates Delhi, Mumbai Petrol, Diesel Price Hiked India LIVE Updates: The petrol will now cost Rs 97.77 per litre in Delhi, Rs 108.74 per litre in Kolkata, Rs 106.68 in Mumbai and Rs
stories.summary: Petrol and diesel prices have been hiked, with petrol now costing Rs 97.77 per litre in Delhi, Rs 108.74 per litre in Kolkata, Rs 106.68 per litre in Mumbai, and Rs 103.67 per litre in Chennai. Diesel prices have also increased, with rates at Rs 90.67 per litre in Delhi, Rs 95.13 per litre in Kolkata, and Rs 93.14 per litre in Mumbai. The hike is attributed to growing pressure on retail fuel markets amid international crude price fluctuations. In some states, including Telangana, Kerala, and Andhra Pradesh, petrol prices have crossed Rs 110 per litre, while diesel prices are nearing Rs 100 per litre. The price increase varies by city, with Delhi seeing a hike of Rs 3, Kolkata seeing a hike of Rs 3.29 for petrol and Rs 3.11 for diesel, and Mumbai seeing a hike of Rs 3.14 for petrol.

stories.headline: NEET UG exam 2026 rescheduled for June 21 after paper leak row India News: NEW DELHI: The National Testing Agency on Friday announced that the re-examination for NEET (UG) 2026 will be held on June 21, Sunday.The decision c
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has rescheduled the NEET (UG) 2026 exam for June 21, following the cancellation of the original exam held on May 3 due to allegations of a paper leak. The re-examination will take place on Sunday, June 21. The decision to cancel the original exam was made after reports of a 'guess paper' leak surfaced, prompting an investigation. The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is involved in the probe. The NEET (UG) exam is a crucial entrance test for undergraduate courses in medical colleges, and the cancellation and rescheduling have affected thousands of students who appeared for the exam. The NTA has officially announced the new exam date, providing students with a new opportunity to take the test.

stories.headline: She wanted to know time, was asked to hop on bus: Survivor recalls moments before Delhi gangrape Moments after she stepped inside, the bus started moving. The man allegedly pushed her towards the back of the vehicle and raped her while it was on the move.
stories.summary: A woman who survived a gangrape in Delhi recalled the moments before the incident, stating she was asked to hop on a bus after inquiring about the time from a man standing near the roadside. The man allegedly dragged her inside a sleeper bus, which started moving immediately. She was then pushed towards the back of the vehicle and raped while it was on the move. The survivor reported that she pleaded with the accused to let her go, but was physically assaulted before being thrown out of the bus. The accused fled the scene, and the woman was left to fend for herself after being forced out of the moving vehicle. The incident is a disturbing reminder of the violence and trauma inflicted upon the survivor.

stories.headline: Rahul Gandhi's fresh swipe at PM Modi over India-US trade deal: 'Compromised PM' India News: NEW DELHI: Leader of opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi on Friday lashed out at Prime Minister Narendra Modi over the India-US trade deal, accusin
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, has criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi over the India-US trade deal, alleging it was made to benefit Gautam Adani. Gandhi's comments came after a New York Times report stated the US is considering dropping bribery charges against Adani. He accused Modi of striking a "deal for Adani's release," invoking his "compromised PM" remark. This is not the first time Gandhi has targeted Modi over the trade deal and foreign policy. He has repeatedly hit out at the Prime Minister, questioning his decisions and motives. The criticism follows a pattern of Gandhi's sharp attacks on Modi's government, with the opposition leader seeking to highlight perceived flaws in the administration's policies and actions. Gandhi's remarks are the latest in an ongoing exchange between the opposition and the government.

stories.headline: Local Farming Faces Hidden Fuel Costs: How Geopolitics Ripple Through Food Economy Fuel costs surge past $6–$7 a gallon, tightening margins for farmers, ranchers, and market vendors already hit by tariffs and input costs.
stories.summary: US farmers are facing significant challenges due to surging fuel costs, with diesel prices exceeding $6-$7 per gallon. This increase, driven by geopolitical tensions such as the US war with Iran, is tightening margins for farmers, ranchers, and market vendors already affected by tariffs and high input costs. Rising fertilizer costs, tied to global shipping disruptions, are also squeezing farmers, forcing cutbacks that may reduce crop yields and supply. The Mississippi Delta, a crucial agricultural region, is particularly impacted, with farmers struggling to cope with the effects of tariffs, fuel, and fertilizer costs. As a result, higher input costs and food prices are likely to follow, affecting the entire country. The timing of these increases is especially problematic, coinciding with the spring planting season and exacerbating existing challenges for farmers.

stories.headline: Local Farming Faces Hidden Fuel Cost Crisis: How Geopolitics Ripple Through Food Economy Fuel costs surge past $6–$7 a gallon, tightening margins for farmers, ranchers, and market vendors already hit by tariffs and input costs.
stories.summary: Fuel costs have surged past $6-$7 a gallon, tightening margins for local farmers, ranchers, and market vendors. These groups are already struggling with tariffs and high input costs. The increase in fuel prices is attributed to geopolitical tensions, including the conflict in Iran. As a result, farmers and small business owners are facing significant additional expenses, with some spending thousands more on fuel, fertilizer, and feed. This surge in costs is raising concerns about the food supply and long-term economic implications for the agricultural industry. Diesel prices, in particular, have increased substantially, affecting farmers and vendors who rely on fuel for their operations. The combined impact of fuel costs, tariffs, and input costs is putting pressure on the local farming economy.

stories.headline: Top US Veterinary Professor Explains How Pets Can Lower Stress And Improve Survival Rates
stories.summary: A top US veterinary professor explains that pets can lower stress and improve survival rates. Research suggests that pet ownership can increase survival rates after serious health events, with a 34% higher survival rate one year after a heart attack or stroke. A 2022 survey found that over one-third of US adults feel completely overwhelmed by stress on most days, which can lead to negative health consequences such as cancer, heart disease, and dementia. Studies have also shown that growing up with pets can influence how the body responds to stress later in life. Additionally, research has found that dogs can mitigate human stress in a biologically complex way, affecting cortisol and alpha-amylase levels. Overall, the evidence suggests that pets can have a significant impact on both physical and mental health. Pet ownership is associated with reduced stress and improved health outcomes.

stories.headline: No fourth option available
stories.summary: Jack Carr's book "The Fourth Option" is a thriller that showcases his approach to storytelling as a craftsman. Unlike some writers who produce books quickly, Carr refines his stories with precision. For the latest news and updates, readers can turn to reputable sources such as CBS News, Vanguard, or CNN. These outlets provide breaking news coverage of national and international events, including politics, entertainment, and sports. CBS News offers in-depth coverage of US news, while Vanguard focuses on Nigerian news and CNN provides global coverage, including news from Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas. These sources can help readers stay informed about current events and find new authors like Jack Carr to enjoy. Carr's writing style and the latest news can be found through these various media outlets.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty end lower as rupee hits record low and inflation fears return Indian equities closed lower as the rupee sank to an all-time low and investors turned cautious.
stories.summary: Indian equities closed lower as the rupee sank to an all-time low, with the Sensex and Nifty ending the day in decline. The rupee slid past the 96-per-dollar level, weighed down by surging oil prices and outflow strain. This marks a weekly loss for Indian shares, with the Sensex falling 5,252 points over the last six trading sessions. The combined market capitalisation of BSE-listed stocks has also declined significantly. Inflation fears have returned, contributing to the cautious investor sentiment. The Nifty dropped below 23,400, while the S&P 500 futures fell 0.2%. The Indian economy is reeling from the oil shock, with $20 billion lost and the rupee at record lows. The decline in Indian equities and the rupee's slide have raised concerns about the country's economic outlook.

stories.headline: Stock Market Today: Dalal Street Starts Firm; Sensex Tops 75,400, Nifty Holds Above 23,760 At Opening Bell
stories.summary: The Indian stock market started firm on a particular day, with the Sensex topping 75,400 and the Nifty holding above 23,760 at the opening bell. IT stocks drove market momentum, leading to a positive opening for Dalal Street. The GIFT Nifty on NSE IX advanced 49 points, or 0.21%, to trade at 23,472. This comes after a significant decline in the previous session, where the S&P BSE Sensex plummeted 1,190.34 points to 79,043.74, and the NSE Nifty50 fell 360.75 points to 23,914.15. The market opened higher despite mixed global cues, a weakening rupee, and rising crude oil prices, with investors remaining cautious. The Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex had previously declined 187.95 points and 724.60 points, respectively, amid weakness in financial stocks.

stories.headline: OMC Stocks Fall Up to 2.65% Despite Hike in Petrol, Diesel Prices
stories.summary: State-run oil marketing companies' (OMCs) stocks fell up to 2.65% despite a hike in petrol and diesel prices. BPCL's share price fell 2% to ₹289 on the NSE, while HPCL's share price fell 3% to its day's low of ₹376. On the BSE, HPCL shares fell 2.65% to ₹367.10, and BPCL declined 2% to ₹289.05. IOCL slipped 0.6% to its day's low of ₹139.35. The price hike of ₹3 per litre for petrol and diesel, and ₹2 per kg for CNG, was lower than expected, contributing to weak investor sentiment. Rising global crude prices also impacted OMC stocks. The modest gains in the Sensex and Nifty, driven by IT and auto sectors, did not offset the decline in OMC stocks, which were affected by the fuel price hike and global market trends.

stories.headline: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals negative open; India hikes fuel prices; Asia markets decline
stories.summary: India's stock market is expected to open lower on Tuesday, following weak global cues. The Nifty50 and Sensex may see a weak start, as indicated by GIFT Nifty signals. Asian markets, including Japan's Nikkei and Hang Seng, are trading lower, with the Nikkei down 998 points to 49,325 and Hang Seng falling 368 points to 26,000. This comes as the US S&P 500 and Nasdaq surged to record-high closes overnight. Meanwhile, India has hiked retail fuel prices for the first time in four years, amid tensions related to the US-Iran conflict. The hike in fuel prices and decline in Asian markets are likely to impact the Indian stock market's performance on Tuesday. The Nifty and Sensex are expected to open lower, in line with the negative trend in global markets.

stories.headline: Costco Pakenham’s $74m mega-store faces make-or-break vote
stories.summary: Cardinia Shire councillors will decide on a permit for Costco Pakenham's $74 million mega-store next week. The proposed store, slated to open in 2027, would be the brand's fifth Victorian warehouse and feature a superstore and mega fuel station. Officers are set to move a motion of approval for the project. The development has been seen as a "vote of confidence" in Victoria, with expectations that it will boost commercial property values in the area. Planning experts believe Costco has a better chance of approval in Pakenham compared to a previously proposed site in Officer South. The outcome of the vote will determine the fate of the project, which is part of Costco's expansion plans in Australia, including the opening of its 17th store in Perth. A decision is expected next week.

stories.headline: Is cash still needed in our increasingly contactless world?
stories.summary: Ireland has shifted towards digital payment methods, with contactless payments becoming increasingly common at various locations. This trend is expected to continue, potentially leading to a decline in the use of cash. The Visa Consumer Payment Attitudes study suggests that digital payments are gaining popularity, which could impact the dominance of cash. Companies like Square and PayPal are benefiting from this trend, with their stocks surging as people opt for digital payments over physical bills and coins. With high mobile phone penetration in countries like the UK, mobile contactless payments are expected to rise, contributing to an increasingly contactless world. As convenience often drives consumer behavior, cash may eventually lose its status as the preferred payment method, paving the way for a more digital and contactless future.

stories.headline: Gambling.com Group Limited (GAMB) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
stories.summary: Gambling.com Group Limited reported Q1 2026 earnings, exceeding EPS and revenue forecasts. Revenue remained flat at $40.4 million, with adjusted EBITDA at $9 million. The company's sports data services revenue increased 13% year-over-year, offset by a decline in marketing revenue. Gambling.com Group is transitioning to an AI-first operational model, with strategic partnerships in place. Co-founder and incoming CEO Kevin McCrystle noted the revenue was in line with the prior year, while adjusted EBITDA reflected the impact of regulatory changes and search ranking pressures on marketing. The company, incorporated in 2006 and based in Jersey, reported results that included a mix of growth in sports data services and challenges in marketing, with total returns available as of May 14, 2026.
